purpose: Regression floor for migration-chain coherence. PR #881 recovered 88 migrations that the 2026-09-26 reset had deleted, and recovering a file is not the same as proving it is sound. This gate measures whether those migrations can rebuild the brain schema from empty. It currently reports 11 UNCREATED_DEPENDENCY defects, and this floor records that number so the defect count can never silently grow.
what_this_means: The migrations depend on 11 core tables that NO migration creates, including the canonical event store (nayanet_cognition_events) and v7_smart_note_transactions, which the chain contract names as the only legal source of Intelligent Block identity. These tables predate the migration history and were created directly in the live database. Therefore master-plan item 26 (Rebuildability) and item 27 (Disaster Recovery) are NOT SATISFIED, and the brain schema cannot currently be reconstructed from source. This is a measured finding, not an opinion.
how_to_lower_this_floor: Author the missing CREATE TABLE migrations in dependency order and re-run the gate. Lower the floor only when the gate itself reports a lower count. Never lower it to make a build green. Control 5 in verify-migration-coherence-controls.py proves that supplying the missing CREATE statements drives the count to zero, so the findings are real and mechanically fixable rather than a hardcoded list.
authority_note: Authoring those migrations is real schema work against the canonical brain and belongs to whoever holds schema authority. This baseline records the defect; it does not decide or perform the repair.
